evals.name: explicit-create-preserves-dirty-work
evals.prompt: 帮我从当前分支创建 feat/login-redirect。当前未提交文件是本次工作，需要一起带过去。
evals.expected_output: Inspect and create the exact branch in this turn, retaining working files and index state.
expectations: Creates the exact named branch without redundant confirmation
Preserves preexisting dirty content and staged state
Does not commit, push, fetch or open a pull request

evals.name: name-only-read-only
evals.prompt: 登录跳转修复，给我一个短分支名和命令，先别创建。
evals.expected_output: Suggest a readable branch name and command; leave checkout unchanged.
expectations: Does not switch or create any branch
Does not commit, push or query remotes
Proposes a short name based on the supplied task

evals.name: requested-base-is-preserved
evals.prompt: 从本地 release 分支创建 feat/login-redirect，工作区干净，不联网。
evals.expected_output: Resolve the local requested base and create there, not at the current branch HEAD.
expectations: New branch starts at the requested local release ref
Does not fetch or silently substitute current HEAD
